stable.title: DroidDeck 0.5.0
stable.summary: • Added SteamVR on Meta Quest 3 and 3S from the standard APK. Quest headsets are detected automatically and get their own driver defaults. Immersive SteamVR runs through a native OpenXR activity with headset tracking, Touch controllers and haptics, and SteamVR's dashboard and Steam library work in VR. (@xXJSONDeruloXx, @Jagger15, #642, #910, #733, #853, #905)

preview.title: fix: let x86 apps under FEX use the device's fonts (Epic launcher CJK text shows boxes)
preview.summary: When the Epic Games Launcher shows its UI in Chinese, every Chinese character is drawn as an empty box (tofu). Tabs, the search box, filters, buttons and the 「」 around game titles are all affected. The same goes for Japanese and Korean, and for any other x86 Linux app run under FEX (Qt, GTK or WebKit) that draws CJK text with system fonts.

Previously, lifting the non-anchor finger at the end of a two-finger scroll left lastX/lastY at the pre-scroll anchor position, so the next single-finger ACTIONMOVE jumped the cursor by the entire scroll distance.
• Finding #63: Add scrollLocked latch and hys

recentPreviews.summary:
• ModeHeader (used in StorePage Flathub Discover and StoresPage store library/catalog headers) previously passed
ocusOnShow = true unconditionally to AdbTextField.
• Because ModeHeader is inside a LazyVerticalGrid header item, whenever a user had a non-empty search query and scrolled down until the header left composition (or switched tabs) and then scrolled back up, ModeHeader re-entered composit

recentPreviews.title: Restore Xbox launches from Steam
recentPreviews.summary: The one-use authorization added to the Xbox Play flow blocks launching an installed Xbox shortcut directly from Steam. This restores the same launch behavior users get with other stores while keeping Xbox preparation bound to a live DroidDeck session, a signed-in Xbox account, and an installed product.

recentPreviews.title: Restrict Xbox credential IPC and address launch review findings
recentPreviews.summary: Xbox launch preparation exposed an account-wide credential socket to guest code. This follow-up to #1156 moves licensed launch-view preparation into an Android-owned backend and returns only a product/account/session launch lease, prepared executable, existing game-service connection and PlayFab game token. Credential IPC now checks the Android-owned PRoot tracer and mapped backend executable agai

recentPreviews.title: Add experimental Xbox and PC Game Pass store support
recentPreviews.summary: Adds Xbox / PC Game Pass as a native DroidDeck store, using a pinned Nexus-patched Xodus backend built for Linux AArch64. Microsoft sign-in, owned/subscription library entries, package selection, licensed downloads with pause/resume, update/verify, related-content management, and a dedicated Proton/FEX launch path use DroidDeck's existing UI and queue.

recentPreviews.title: fix: adding a games folder on an SD card found nothing
recentPreviews.summary: What was wrong, in plain terms: adding a games folder that sits on an SD card (anywhere outside DroidDeck's own Steam library folder) found nothing. The app showed "Nothing new in this folder" and no games were added, even though the folder was full of games.

recentPreviews.title: Fix intermittent CI package updates and escaped test worker
recentPreviews.summary: Build APK intermittently lost its test JVM because CloudSavesTest started a 60-second worker that kept accessing Android preferences after Robolectric reset its context. Let the test capture deferred work through an internal executor overload and use a plain test application. The runtime entry point keeps the same worker and polling behavior.

recentPreviews.title: fix: run x86 Proton under FEX in the Steam runtime it requires
recentPreviews.summary: x86-64 Proton (e.g. Proton Experimental / 11) run through droiddeck-fex never got past startup on the Thor. Three separate problems, all in the FEX launch path:

Any program that patches its own ntdll with WriteProcessMemory / NtWriteVirtualMemory hits the same wall: hook engines, overlays, launchers and some anti-tamp

tests.summary: Native Linux games run with the "Linux x86 (FEX)" tool get no sound when they play through ALSA. The game runs and the Steam UI keeps its sounds, but the game log shows:

tests.title: fix: add a picked exe the session cannot see by binding its folder
tests.summary: Adding a game from a single EXE on a microSD card (or any folder outside internal storage and the game library) shows "This location is not available in the session" and adds nothing. A 100 GB game on the card cannot be added at all.

tests.title: fix: Steam no longer sleeps again right after a paused session resumes
tests.summary:
When a Steam session came back after being paused longer than Steam's own idle-sleep timeout, Steam put itself to sleep again straight away:
• the session paused again a second after Resume, so it needed a second Resume, or
• the game dropped behind Big Picture, with its audio still playing.

tests.title: fix: find and save Steam touch layouts of non-Steam shortcuts
tests.summary: The Steam touch layout editor (on-screen controls: Steam touch) opens "App -<n> Layout" for a non-Steam shortcut, such as an added game or the Epic Games Launcher. LB, LT, RT, RB, both sticks and LS/RS are greyed out and cannot be dragged onto the screen, so the left stick can never be placed for movement.

tests.title: fix: GOG games miss the registry entries their install script sets
tests.summary: GOG downloads only place the game's files. GOG's own installer also writes the registry entries listed in the game's install script, goggame-<id>.script. Games that look up their own keys find nothing. For example, Fallout: New Vegas reads HKLM\Software\Bethesda Softworks\FalloutNV → Installed Path, and without it the game shows "Fallout: New Vegas does not appear to be installed and the i

tests.title: fix: add games picked inside a folder game as their own games
tests.summary: Adding a non-Steam game could replace one you already had instead of adding a new one. Picking the second game's exe switched the first game's target (it kept the first game's name and artwork), and when the first game was removed, picking any other game brought it back.

tests.title: fix: show the app's cursor in sessions started from the front end
tests.summary: Apps started from the front end (store apps, Flatpaks, emulators, anything in a run-mode session) had no cursor of their own. In a fresh app process you got DroidDeck's fallback arrow, and after a desktop session had been used the cursor was gone completely, while mouse and touchpad input still worked.

tests.title: feat: run SteamOS PipeWire and WirePlumber for gamescope screen capture
tests.summary: Remote Play from DroidDeck showed a black screen on the client: audio and input streamed, but there was no picture. Gamescope publishes its picture as a PipeWire stream, and Steam's Remote Play and game recording capture from it. The session never starts a PipeWire daemon, so gamescope logged pipewire: pwcontextconnect failed / failed to setup PipeWire, screen capture won't be available, and

tests.title: steam: exclude Valve tools from compat reconciliation and wire EAC ru…
tests.summary:
Fixes two issues affecting Steam compatibility tool management and anti-cheat runtime discovery:
1. Steam compatibility helper (droiddeck-steam-compat) crash loop on installed tools/runtimes:
When legacy or uncatalogued Steam tools (such as Proton 5.0 1245040) are installed, they were treated as regular games and passed to CompatManager.GetCompatTools#1. Steam rejects non-game/tool App IDs with EResult 128, which previously threw an unhandled error inside self.many(), aborting reconcile() and preventing ensuretools() from running.
2. Missing Easy Anti-Cheat (PROTONEACRUNTIME) and BattlEye (PROTONBATTLEYERUNTIME) runtime wiring:
droiddeck-game-env did not discover or export PROTONEACRUNTIME or PROTONBATTLEYERUNTIME when launching games through Proton, leaving Proton's wine-eac bridge unconfigured even when Proton EasyAntiCheat Runtime (1826330) or Proton BattlEye Runtime (1161040) was installed.
## Changes

tests.title: Add opt-in Pixel WoW64 and D3D9 compatibility tools
tests.summary: American Nightmare (Steam 202750) on the tested Pixel PowerVR/WoW64 setup first stopped because device-backed GPU allocations mapped above 4 GiB could not be represented by Wine's 32-bit bridge. After that was addressed, the 3D scene showed bright dotted triangle edges over textured geometry. This submits the reviewed, opt-in low32 and D3D9 single-sample workarounds directly to official DroidDeck,

tests.title: fix: find GOG Galaxy SDK cloud saves when remote-config lists no locations
tests.summary: GOG games that use Galaxy SDK IStorage publish cloudStorage.enabled: true with an empty locations array. That is namespace default at %LocalAppData%/GOG.com/Galaxy/Applications/<clientId>/Storage/Shared/Files. DroidDeck treated the empty list as no cloud, so Manage saves showed "No cloud saves" even when the files were on cloudstorage.gog.com.

tests.title: [FIX] statx call on old kernels < 4.11
tests.summary: Fix statx call on old kernels < 4.11 for correct using of "Fast proot path"

tests.title: Retain compositor resources when GPU completion is unconfirmed
tests.summary: Finite fence waits can fail while submitted GPU work is still pending. Continuing or tearing down after that result can reset resources still in use or free image memory before completion. This adds a terminal completion-unknown state that stops further presentation and retains pending resources until the app process exits, while preserving the existing genuine-device-loss path.

tests.title: Controller: stick dead zone setting and per-controller profiles (test build, not for merge yet)
tests.summary: This is for testing only, please don't merge it yet. I want a release-signed test build to try on a Galaxy S25 Ultra with an MCON controller, and I haven't run any of it on a device. I'll say when it has been tried and it's ready for review, or I'll close it. Plan and discussion: #580.

tests.title: Switch the GOG store to GOG's official listing endpoint: fewer requests, the tab now opens in seconds
tests.summary: The GOG tab loaded one game at a time: user/data/games only returns owned ids, so every product needed its own requests for a title, art and details, and the grid stayed empty until the last one came back.

tests.title: a11y: give the button-like clickables a Button role for screen readers
tests.summary: Buttons, tiles, list rows and rail items across the launcher now announce themselves as buttons to a screen reader.

tests.title: feat: tools/device-smoke.sh checks a build on a real device over plain adb
tests.summary: tools/device-smoke.sh checks a build on a real device with nothing but adb, so a change can be tried on a phone or a foldable without python or a rooted device.

tests.title: feat: the unfolded game height can end at a fold line
tests.summary: The sizing rule for putting the game above a fold and the controls below it is now a tested function, so a posture-aware split on foldables can be built on it. Nothing in the app calls it with a fold yet, so there is no behaviour change today.

tests.title: Steam's Wi-Fi and Bluetooth switches show and change the phone's real radios
tests.summary: In Steam's Quick Settings and in its Settings pages (Internet, Bluetooth), Wi-Fi and Bluetooth didn't match the phone. With both on, the QAM showed them off, and flipping either switch changed nothing on the phone.

tests.title: Let a game override the session locale
tests.summary:
Wine takes a game's language and codepage from LANG, and every game runs in
C.UTF-8: the rootfs ships only C.utf8, and the session sets LANG=C.UTF-8 for
the whole guest. A game that reads the locale itself starts with the wrong
language and codepage under that, and will not get past its own startup.

tests.title: fix: hide on-screen controls while the PC keyboard is open
tests.summary: Hide onScreenControls and steamTouchControls while pcKeyboardOpen is active so the touch gamepad overlay does not stay drawn over the on-screen PC keyboard.

tests.title: fix: one refused thermal or power query no longer drops the others from the session report
tests.summary: The session report keeps the thermal headroom and power saver lines when the device refuses the thermal status query, and the other way round; a refused query now shows as "unknown" instead of removing the lines after it.

tests.title: feat: the unfolded controls can stay while a controller is connected
tests.summary: On foldable phones, the Steam Deck controls on the unfolded screen (trackpads and back grips) can now stay visible while a controller is connected. Turn on "Keep them with a controller" under "Controls on the unfolded screen" if you hold your phone in a telescopic controller and still want the on-screen trackpads and back buttons.

tests.title: feat: games show their logo, and store games get one from the store
tests.summary: Games now show their own logo. On the Games page the big title over the game's artwork is replaced by the game's logo when one is available (Steam games, games from GOG, Epic and Amazon, and added games), with the name still shown as text when there is none.
